title: Senior Sales Analyst (f/m/d)
description:
Build the data foundation behind AutoScout24’s commercial decisions.

As a Senior Sales Analyst in our Global Sales Analytics team, you will build and own the analytical data products that power Sales and Revenue Analytics across all AutoScout24 markets.

This is a hands-on technical analytics role, working with complex commercial data across customers, contracts, products, pricing and revenue. The focus is on designing scalable data models, pipelines and reporting layers that provide trusted KPIs across markets.

Close collaboration with leaders across functions will ensure that business needs are translated into robust analytical solutions.

Why this role is unique

  • End-to-end ownership of business-critical Sales and Revenue Analytics data products
  • Direct impact on commercial decisions across AutoScout24 markets, products and pricing models
  • Complex technical challenges across customer, contract, product, pricing and revenue data
  • Opportunity to shape reliable KPI logic, scalable data models and reporting foundations
  • Close partnership with both technical and business stakeholders
  • Exposure to major business changes, including CRM transformations, pricing initiatives and market launches

What you’ll do

  • Own business-critical Sales and Revenue Analytics data products end-to-end – from source data and transformations to reporting and validation
  • Design, build and maintain scalable data models, reporting layers and data pipelines
  • Write and optimise complex SQL and use Python for automation and analytical workflows
  • Troubleshoot pipeline failures, data inconsistencies and complex edge cases across multiple source systems
  • Build reliable KPI logic across markets, products and pricing models
  • Support major business changes such as CRM transformations, pricing initiatives and market launches
  • Use AI-assisted workflows to accelerate coding, debugging and documentation

What you’ll bring

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in Data Analytics, Analytics Engineering, Business Intelligence or a similar technical analytics role
  • Advanced SQL skills and strong hands-on experience working with complex production data
  • Good Python skills for data processing and automation
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining data pipelines and workflow orchestration, ideally with Airflow or similar technologies
  • Strong knowledge of data modelling, transformations, data quality and analytical data products
  • Experience with modern cloud data platforms and BI tools such as AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI or Looker
  • Strong business curiosity and the ability to translate Sales and Revenue questions into robust analytical solutions
  • Confidence working across technical and business stakeholders

What sets you apart

  • A genuine interest in working close to the data – not only building dashboards, but understanding data sources, transformations, differing numbers and the reliability of solutions at scale
  • An engineering mindset combined with analytical curiosity and a high standard for data quality
  • Ownership and confidence in resolving issues when pipelines, data or processes break
  • A desire to pair technical excellence with visible commercial impact, helping AutoScout24 make better decisions across markets

A culture of growth

With over 50 nationalities represented, we’re proud to welcome people of all backgrounds to our growing community, and we’re always finding new ways to help people feel welcomed and included. Here, you’ll have the tools, training and support you need to work in a way that suits you, learn new skills and reach your potential.

For a career where you can drive our business and shape your future, apply now.

title: Senior CRM Manager (F/M/D)
description:
Location: Come and join us either in Barcelona, Berlin or Hamburg!

Freenow by Lyft empowers smarter mobility decisions helping people to move freely and cities to thrive.

We are looking for a senior CRM Manager to join our diverse and driven team. In this role, you’ll play a key part in achieving ambitious growth targets by engaging and retaining our global user base through impactful, data-driven CRM strategies.

YOUR DAILY ADVENTURES WILL INCLUDE:

  • As part of the central CRM team, you will: maximise customer value by defining and implementing lifecycle strategies that activate, engage and retain users across our 9 markets
  • Own end-to-end automation creation process, from ideation to execution, across multiple channels (email, push notifications, in-app, SMS…)
  • Advise and coach more junior team members on best in class CRM for global and local initiatives, ensuring the right message reaches the right user at the right time
  • Optimise performance using behavioural data, designing and analysing A/B tests, and reduce friction in the customer journey
  • Lead cross-functional projects, such as dashboard creation, lifecycle segmentation, process optimisation, and experimentation frameworks
  • Manage and optimise CRM automations, aligning communications and themes with lifecycle stages and business priorities
  • Identify business opportunities and bring them to life together with Marketing, Product, local teams and North American counterparts

TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE:

  • 5+ years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, or customer engagement – ideally at a regional or global level
  • Hands-on experience with CRM platforms (experience with Braze is a plus)
  • Strong project management and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across teams, markets, levels and time zones
  • Ability to effectively prioritise and manage a diverse set of initiatives in a fast-paced environment
  • A data-driven mindset, using both quantitative and qualitative insights to inform decisions
  • Excellent communication skills in English (other European languages are a plus)

BENEFITS & PERKS IN A NUTSHELL:

  • Flexible working arrangements
  • LinkedIn Learning
  • Sabbatical & special leave policies
  • WeRoad partnership
  • Birthday, 24th + 31st December off
  • Short term EU work policy
  • Mobility Credit
  • Health Insurance
  • Employee assistance program
  

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION:

Freenow is an equal opportunity employer and we consider qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age.
 We want you to grow and evolve, bring your true self to work. 

ABOUT FREENOW:

Freenow by Lyft empowers smarter mobility decisions, helping people to move freely and cities to thrive. Through our multi-mobility app, we feature broad options for everyone across 9 European markets and over 180 cities. Millions of passengers can access services including taxis, private hire vehicles, carsharing, car rental, e-scooters, e-bikes, e-mopeds, and public transport within a single app. 

In July 2025 Freenow was acquired by Lyft, a global mobility platform, which connects riders and drivers for billions of rides across North America and Europe. Together, Freenow and Lyft are creating a more caring and connected world, with transportation for everyone. We are a global, diverse, highly motivated, and collaborative team that strives for excellence and likes to have fun. Ready for your next ride?

title: Senior Search Backend Engineer (m/f/x)
description:
About commercetools

Real innovation starts with a strong foundation, and at commercetools, that comes from the perfect balance of our product and our people.

Behind every leap forward is a collective of builders, explorers, doers, makers, and problem-solvers.The kind of people who not only pioneered a more flexible approach to commerce architecture but also shaped the culture of experimentation that approach unlocked. Together, they are the engine of commerce innovation today.

At commercetools, we power the next era of commerce for our customers. Whether it’s AI-driven solutions that help enterprises make smarter business decisions, bridging digital and physical shopping experiences, or enabling entirely new ways for industries to connect with their customers, we help the world’s most ambitious companies experiment, scale, and grow without limits.

Here, the best idea wins, not the loudest voice. You will have the tools, trust, and space to not only build the future of commerce but to build your own.

Your Impact

As a Senior Search Engineer on our Discovery Team, you will build the retrieval layer behind product discovery for some of the world’s most demanding commerce brands.

Search is changing shape. Shoppers type full sentences instead of keywords, and increasingly the client calling our API is an AI agent rather than a person. We are on the path to take our semantic and hybrid retrieval to general availability, and tackling the hard problems: making it fast, affordable, measurably better across enterprise catalogs, and working out what comes after it. You would join that work at every layer, from query understanding down to the vector index and the cost of a single query.

You will:

  • Design and implement search functionalities in a PaaS ecommerce Scala backend
  • Develop search capabilities that combine lexical, semantic, and hybrid retrieval
  • Develop search-related libraries based on ElasticSearch and MongoDB
  • Contribute to search relevance and quality, and to how we measure it
  • Run and maintain a scalable search “infrastructure as code” on top of Kubernetes using terraform and multi-tenant architecture
  • Test software components regarding usability, functionality, and performance, and work closely with Product Management and DevOps
  • Learn Scala and functional programming as your new main development tools
  • Take part in on-call rotation with a worldwide distributed team for production systems

This role is hybrid, with three days a week spent in our Munich, Berlin, London or Valencia office. 

What Sets You Apart

You're a creative problem-solver who is wired to find solutions. You confidently dive into complex challenges and have a talent for making them simple for others. Your curiosity drives you to constantly grow and contribute to an environment of trust and teamwork.

Great ideas come from many paths, and your unique perspective matters more than checking every box. What matters most is the mindset you bring to the work. You do not need to be an ML researcher for this role. You need to be a strong backend engineer who is genuinely interested in retrieval quality.

You bring:

  • At least 5 years of experience as a Software Engineer, with production experience on the JVM
  • Solid understanding of parallel and asynchronous programming, as well as non-blocking I/O
  • Experience developing REST APIs and knowledge of scalable architectures, including sharding, replication, load balancing, and failover
  • Interest in working with Scala using pragmatic functional programming patterns. If you come from another JVM language, we will support you in picking it up.
  • Fluent English for work in international teams
  • Experience operating multi-tenant SaaS where one tenant’s load must never affect another’s
  • Knowledge of scalable event-driven architectures, including queues and notification topics
  • A genuine curiosity for using AI tools to work smarter and more effectively, paired with a drive to learn and put them into practice in your role.

Nice to Have: 

  • Hands-on search experience, preferably ElasticSearch or OpenSearch, including a working understanding of how an inverted index scores and ranks documents
  • Practical exposure to vector retrieval, such as embeddings, approximate nearest neighbor indexes, and hybrid ranking, and a sense of where each approach breaks down. A deep lexical search background plus a clear appetite to go into this territory also works.
  • Comfort reasoning about relevance with data, including precision and recall tradeoffs, ranking metrics, and behavioral signals
  • Experience with infrastructure work and other technologies like Helm, Kubernetes, and Rust

Our Benefits

Because work and life are connected, our benefits are too. We’ve designed them to give you the security, flexibility, and opportunities you need to focus on what matters most.

🩺 Comprehensive health benefits for you and your dependents, including access to OpenUp for personalized mental health support

📚 Learning and development opportunities including an annual learning budget, access to self-paced learning platforms and language training, personalized coaching, mentorship, and leadership programs

🍼 Family Leave Plus gives you additional fully paid weeks of parental leave on top of government-provided leave, so you can spend more time with your new addition

📈 Our equity participation program allows you to share in our success 

For more information on our benefits, visit this page.

Come as you are. Build with us.

Your unique perspective is essential to our success. We are committed to building a team that reflects the world around us because we know it’s the only way to build the future. We celebrate our differences and have created a hiring process that’s fair, inclusive, and designed to let your talent shine.

We proudly welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, and any other part of your identity that makes you who you are. As an equal opportunity employer, we believe that our strength lies in our diversity, and we invite you to be a part of our global community. 

For more information on our diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging practices, visit this page.

title: Technical Onboarding Specialist - Praxissoftware (x/f/m)
description:
Du bringst Leidenschaft für Technik, Service und die Zufriedenheit unserer Kund:innen  mit -und möchtest von Anfang an Teil der Customer Journey sein? Dann bist Du hier richtig.Im Technical Onboarding begleitest Du Praxen und Krankenhäuser bei der Einführung unserer Produkte und sorgst dafür, dass sie von Tag 1 an reibungslos mit Doctolib arbeiten können. Während des Onboardings unterstützt Du komplexe IT-Fälle und implementierst neben unserer Praxissoftware weitere Produkte wie den KI-basierten Telefonassistenten und unsere Terminverwaltungslösung. Du musst nicht vom ersten Tag an alles wissen. Mit Deinen fundierten Grundlagen und Deiner Motivation wächst Du bei uns in neue Themen hinein.

Deine Aufgaben 

  • Datenmigration mit Wirkung: Du sorgst dafür, dass Patienten- und Termindaten sicher und sauber aus alten Praxissystemen in unsere Software wandern – du bringst Ordnung ins Datenchaos und machst den Umstieg für Praxen so reibungslos wie möglich.
  • Dein Draht zu den Praxen: Du kommunizierst proaktiv, wenn es technisch wird – ob per Telefon oder E-Mail. Du prüfst dabei, dass alles stimmt, bevor es losgehen kann, und begleitest die Praxen durchs gesamte Onboarding.
  • Inhouse-Expertin für alle: Sales, Deployment & Co. verlassen sich auf dich, wenn's knifflig wird. Systemkonfigurationen, API-Anbindungen, komplexe Onboarding-Fälle – du bist die Person, die Antworten hat.
  • Alles verbinden: Du integrierst unsere All-in-One-Software in bestehende Praxisverwaltungssysteme und richtest Schnittstellen ein – damit am Ende alles nahtlos zusammenspielt.
  • Raum für eigene Ideen: Trainings entwickeln, Prozesse automatisieren, im Innovation Lab tüfteln – bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, über den Tellerrand zu schauen und echte Verbesserungen anzustoßen.

Dein Profil

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringst Du Folgendes mit:

  • Daten sind dein Spielfeld: Du kennst dich mit Excel (oder ähnlichen Tools) richtig gut aus und hast zumindest erste Berührungspunkte mit SQL oder Regular Expressions – du weißt, wie man Daten in Form bringt.
  • Sprachen: Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch – ob Hochdeutsch, Bayerisch oder Berlinerisch, du verstehst deine Kunden und bist auch sicher in der Englischen Kommunikation
  • Tech-Basics sitzen: APIs, IT-Infrastrukturen, Netzwerke, VPNs – kein Neuland für dich. Du weißt, wie die Dinge zusammenhängen.
  • Kommunikation ist deine Stärke: Ob am Telefon oder im Online-Meeting mit Kund:innen – du findest die richtigen Worte, auch wenn's technisch wird.
  • Neu klingt für Dich spannend: Du hast ein Auge fürs Detail und bist neugierig auf neue Themen – besonders wenn sie mit Gesundheitstechnologie und digitalen Prozessen zu tun haben.

Das ist ein Plus - oder Du lernst es bei uns:

  • Coding-Erfahrung in JavaScript und/oder Python sowie mit SQL-Datenbanken? Super – zeig uns, was du gebaut hast!
  • Kenntnisse in Patientenverwaltungssystemen oder EHR-Systemen – wenn du weißt, wie Praxen digital ticken, ist das ein echter Bonus.
  • SaaS & KI im Alltag – du hast schon mit SaaS-Tools gearbeitet oder KI sinnvoll in deinen Workflow integriert? Noch besser!

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Ein von Doctolib gesponsertes Deutschlandticket, wenn Du aus dem Büro oder im Hybridmodus arbeitest
  • Eine betriebliche Krankenversicherung mit tollen Zusatzleistungen
  • 28 Urlaubstage + 1 Tag zusätzlich für jedes volle Beschäftigungs-Kalenderjahr (max. 30 Tage)
  • Die Möglichkeit, bis zu 10 Tage im Jahr aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten
  • Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) mit einem Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 40% (15% während der Probezeit) 
  • Das Doctolib Parent Care Programm, das einen Monat Elternzeit extra u.v.m. enthält
  • Kostenlose Mental Health- und Coaching-Sessions über einen externen Partner 
  • Zusätzlich zu gesunden Snacks und einem regelmäßigen Frühstücksbuffet, bieten wir Essensgutscheine
  • Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club
  • Für pflegende Betreuungspersonen und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen gibt es ein Angebot, das flexiblere Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung aus medizinischen Gründen und psychologische Unterstützung beinhaltet
  • KI im Alltag: Du arbeitest täglich mit modernsten KI-Systemen und hast direkten Einfluss darauf, wie sie sich weiterentwickeln
  • Teilnahme an Doctolibs langfristigem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth

Der Interviewprozess

  • Erstes Gespräch mit Talent Acquisition
  • Technical Assessment (Take Home) & Interview mit der Fachabteilung
  • Finales Interview mit dem Management
  • Mindestens eine Referenzprüfung

Job Details

  • Festanstellung
  • Vollzeit
  • Gehaltspaket: 44-48.000€ brutto/jährlich (inkl. 10% Bonus)
  • Berlin

  • Hybrid erlaubt  (2 Tage Homeoffice / Woche)

Wir zeigen die vollständige Gehaltsspanne aus Transparenzgründen, damit du nachvollziehen kannst, wie sich deine Vergütung mit deiner Entwicklung bei uns verändert. Das Maximum ist nicht der Einstiegspunkt – es ist das Ziel.

 

Wir verfolgen die Vision, die Gesundheit aller zu verbessern. Dies spiegelt sich auch im Recruiting wider. Wir evaluieren Bewerbungen ausschließlich auf der Grundlage von Qualifikation und Motivation. Diskriminierung wird bei uns nicht toleriert.

title: VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring
description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

  • Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
  • Over 2 million members: 900,000 UK and 1,100,000 in India and growing rapidly
  • Over $300 million raised in funding
  • Over 2,800 Tideans globally
  • Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
  • We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE ROLE

Tide is hiring a VP of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Ongoing Monitoring. You will report directly to the Chief Data and Technology Officer. Ongoing Monitoring protects our members by detecting fraud, financial crime and regulatory risk across every transaction Tide processes. The engineering, data science and platform capability behind it is one of the most technically demanding estates at Tide.

You will be accountable for the engineering strategy, organisation and execution across all Ongoing Monitoring value streams: real-time transaction monitoring for bank payments fraud, acquiring fraud, Anti Money Laundering, Counter Terrorist Financing, sanctions and prohibited activities monitoring, and the tooling our financial investigators depend on. That means ML models in production, agentic AI inside regulated workflows, and multi-market screening infrastructure that stands up to regulatory scrutiny.

This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, near real-time platform engineering and applied AI. Our first line operations teams are the primary internal customer, our second line sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise detection quality and reduce fraud losses while driving the cost of monitoring per member down, and scale agentic solutions where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.

As VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring you will:

  • Set the engineering strategy for Tide's fraud, financial crime and ongoing monitoring platforms
  • Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science, ML engineering and analytics engineering, primarily based in Hyderabad with product leadership split between Hyderabad and London
  • Lead managers and senior engineers, and build the leadership bench underneath you
  • Work with multiple stakeholders across risk, operations, business, design, product and engineering
  • Own the Decision Engine and Decision Intelligence Platform as shared capabilities, unifying domestic and international payment flows
  • Own the model lifecycle end to end, from development through backtesting, shadow deployment and staged rollout to production performance monitoring
  • Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, including migrating Ongoing Monitoring agents onto Tide's shared agentic infrastructure and holding the line on our agentic governance framework
  • Deliver measurable risk and efficiency outcomes: lower fraud losses, higher automated alert throughput, and a falling ongoing monitoring cost per member
  • Build the operating model that connects first line operations, second line risk and compliance, payments and acquiring engineering, KYX, AI Platforms and data science leadership behind one roadmap
  • Apply principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated

This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. Ongoing Monitoring is where we prove that trust scales, across every transaction we process. You will shape how quickly we protect our members, how confidently we enter new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Experience leading engineering organisations in fraud, financial crime, risk or another real-time decisioning domain
  • Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes across fraud detection and mitigation, unit economics reduction and workflows automation
  • Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live and fast iteration of model development 
  • Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with second line risk and compliance functions and with regulators
  • Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality
  • Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and align several functions behind one roadmap, operating model and set of priorities
  • Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight would be a bonus

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans: 

  • Competitive Compensation –  Competitive salary and share options.
  • Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
  • Parental Leave – Maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
  • Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
  • Health Insurance – Public health insurance plan.
  • Retirement Planning – Public pension scheme on eligible earnings.
  • DeutschlandTicket via Spendit - Employer funded free, unlimited travel throughout Germany on all local public transport (not valid in ICE, IC/EC).
  • Urban Sports Club Membership - Employer funded M membership to help you live a healthy and active lifestyle.
  • Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
  • Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
  • Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
  • WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
  • Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
  • Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community. 

#LI-AC1 #LI-Remote

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

title: UVC Partners: Data & AI - Master Thesis / Internship (f/m/x)
description: About us UVC Partners is one of Europe’s leading early-stage venture capital firms. With our fourth fund generation of €250 million, we invest in disruptive B2B startups at the seed and Series A stage across Europe. Our focus areas include enterprise software, mobility, and industrial technologies. Headquartered in Munich and closely integrated with UnternehmerTUM, Europe’s largest entrepreneurship center, we are proud partners to some of Europe’s most ambitious founders – including Flixbus, Isar Aerospace, finn.auto, Proxima Fusion, and Aleph Alpha. At UVC Partners, we’re driven by a deep passion for entrepreneurship and its power to positively shape society. Environmental and social responsibility are core to our DNA. We hold ourselves to the highest standards in everything we do. As a firm, we continuously reinvent ourselves to stay ahead and best serve our portfolio and investors. We believe in ownership over hierarchy and foster a culture built on collaboration, curiosity, and personal engagement. And while we’re serious about our mission, we also genuinely enjoy working together and building lasting relationships along the way. Your mission You will join a specialized team working at the intersection of applied research and venture capital, side by side with investors, AI researchers, and engineers building the backbone of our investment intelligence. This is a hands-on role with real stakes. You will be treated as a full member of the team, expected to take a research question from literature to a working prototype and to present your results to the people who make the investment decisions. Your profile You are enrolled in a Master’s program in Computer Science, Data Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a similar program at a top university. You bring depth, or the ambition to build it, in at least one relevant toolkit, whether that is graph ML and graph databases (e.g. PyTorch Geometric), LLM tooling, tool use and evaluation, or probabilistic modeling (e.g. PyMC, NumPyro). You write clean, modular Python and have firm machine learning and statistics fundamentals. You are fluent with AI-assisted coding tools and you have judgment about them. You know what they do well, where they quietly fail, and you review everything they produce. You do not ship AI slop. You work independently. You have run a project where you set the direction yourself, and you can point to it. You are fluent in English, including technical language. It is what you will work, write, and present in. German is helpful but not required. How we work We are an AI-powered development team . Everyone here codes with AI assistance, and we treat that as a craft. You need to know which parts of a problem to hand over, where these tools fail quietly, and how to review output you did not write. Agency matters a lot in our team. You get mentorship, context, and access to everyone. You do not get someone assigning you tasks every morning. Take a rough problem statement, come back with an approach, show drafts while they can still change, and flag what is not working. What you bring should outweigh what it costs us to support you. Potential Research Directions These are directions we could explore, with scope defined together at the start based on your background and where the work leads. 1. With Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) we would work on a graph-structured database, where people and companies are nodes and the relationships between them are part of the data, and ask what that structure can tell us that a table cannot. 2. With Program-aided Language Models (PAL) we would have the model write a small program for every number it pulls from decks and financial statements, so figures are accurately computed, because that is what makes it safe to point a language model at financial data. 3. And with Bayesian Updating we would keep our recorded understanding of a company moving as new evidence arrives, since the investment process is iterative and a view written down two years ago should not still be the view today. Your thesis could focus on one of these, though as a full-time member of the team you will work across several. Academic Supervision: The Lead of the Data & AI Team is a PhD candidate at TUM's School of Computation, Information and Technology (CIT) and can supervise CIT masters students directly, so there is no separate supervisor search. However, you are free to choose your own supervisor and candidates from other universities bring their own. What we offer Network: A desk at the Munich Urban Colab, our main office, with the option of a second one in Garching, plus access to the UnternehmerTUM ecosystem of startups, experts, and investors. Team & Culture: Monthly team lunches, our regular Stammtisch, free sports classes, Makerspace access for your personal projects, and regular team events. Compensation: An attractive salary for the full six months of your master thesis or internship. Ownership: Research that is yours end to end and feeds real fund decisions. Equipment: A MacBook or a Windows laptop, whichever you work best on. AI Tooling: Full access to the AI development stack we use daily, and a team that will teach you to use it properly. Real Data: Proprietary venture data that researchers rarely get access to, with the pipelines to use it productively. Interested? Please send a one-page CV, a current transcript, and a link to your GitHub or portfolio. Tell us which of these directions interests you most and why. We look forward to hearing from you! Diversity is important to us Diversity enriches our team. We explicitly encourage all qualified individuals to apply, regardless of gender, social and ethnic background, sexual orientation, religion, age, or disability. UVC Partners is an independent venture capital fund. For efficiency, we use certain shared services from UnternehmerTUM. This is why parts of the application process may appear UTUM-branded, and your application will be processed by UVC Partners and UnternehmerTUM. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Business Developer - National Security
description:
Introduction 

We are proud of the work we do in National Security and the difference it makes to the safety and prosperity of the UK. We are looking for an experienced business developer / account manager to join our thriving Defence and Security Business Unit and grow our National Security business — bringing established sector experience, a strong network of contacts, and a track record of building trusted client relationships that turn into repeat business and deliver real impact.

Main purpose of the job 

As Senior Business Developer / Account Manager, you will join an established commercial team working with clients across the National Security community. You will own and grow an area of our National Security business, using your existing relationships and sector knowledge to identify opportunities, shape work programmes and develop the commercial approach to bids, working on your own initiative to build your own line of business. Key client relationships and repeat business built on trust are the cornerstone of our commercial approach, and your responsibilities will include client management during project delivery. 

This role is based in Cheltenham, with occasional travel to our Cambridge office.

Responsibilities 

  • Develop and own your plan for growing business within a National Security account 
  • Identify and build consultative relationships with key clients and stakeholders across the National Security community, to enable further sales opportunities 
  • Identify sales opportunities and work with our technical teams to shape propositions, maximise conversion and close substantial sales 
  • Support bids with positioning, win themes and pricing strategy 
  • Interact with teams across the whole of Cambridge Consultants to bring the best technology to our clients to solve their problems 
  • Build and maintain deep domain knowledge of the National Security market and its challenges 

What we're looking for 

We are specifically looking for someone with established experience within the National Security sector, an existing network of contacts, and credibility gained through working closely with National Security clients and their delivery partners. You will have exposure to, and ideally direct experience in, one or more of:  

  • Operational Cyber 
  • Novel communications 
  • Operational technology 
  • Artificial Intelligence 

To meet the requirements of this role you will have: 

  • A proven track record in business development or account management within the National Security sector, with evidence of significant sales delivered (e.g. multi-million-pound accounts) 
  • Established relationships and contacts within National Security client organisations and their supply base 
  • Experience developing and executing account plans, and supporting bids with client value proposition, win themes and commercial input 
  • A technical or science background giving you the credibility to engage confidently with technologists and clients alike 
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, and the ability to build trusted relationships quickly 

Previous experience of working in a consultancy, systems integrator, government agency or other 'fee for service' organisation would be an advantage. Due to the nature of the work, this role will be subject to Security Clearance Vetting procedures, and the successful applicant must hold UK nationality. 

 

Type of work undertaken by the division 

The Defence and Security Business Unit specialises in the design and development of innovative solutions for impactful client needs, from early research through to prototype manufacture and long-term delivery of equipment and services. Our workforce has broad expertise across Artificial Intelligence, sensing and data analytics, signal processing, radio frequency engineering, electronics, software development, mechanical design, physics and mathematics, allowing us to develop complete systems for our clients. 

Why Cambridge Consultants? 

Cambridge Consultants creates exciting and novel breakthroughs in technology and products, helping our clients achieve the kind of game-changing leap forward that will transform their whole business. At the heart of what we do are talented, motivated multi-disciplinary teams, empowered to solve difficult problems for our clients. We recognise and celebrate individual talent and support our people to pursue the projects that interest them and develop their careers in whatever direction they choose. Promotion is linked to merit. 

 

By submitting an application to Cambridge Consultants, you confirm that the information provided in this application, together with any supporting documentation, is true, complete, and accurate to the best of your knowledge and belief. You understand that any false statement, misleading information, or material omission may render you liable to disqualification from the recruitment process, withdrawal of any offer of employment, or dismissal without notice if discovered following appointment. You acknowledge that the organisation reserves the right to verify the information supplied.

title: Technical Director, Fire Engineering
description:
Company Overview

Throughout our worldwide network of experts, clients and communities, we are renowned for our leadership in fire protection engineering – a legacy of responsibility we have proudly upheld since 1939. Today, our expertise extends broadly across closely related security and risk-based fields – from accessibility consulting and risk analysis to process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management, digital innovation and more.

Our engineers and consultants collaborate to solve complex safety and security challenges, ensuring our clients can protect what matters most. For over 80 years, we have helped mitigate risks that threaten lives, property and reputations. Through technology, expertise and industry-leading research, we remain dedicated to our purpose of making our world safe, secure and resilient.

At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating and sustaining a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives and talents they bring to our organization.

Our wide range of Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organization, supporting career development and providing forums for individuals to share experiences on topics they’re passionate about. Together, we are cultivating a connected culture where everyone has the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed together.

Why join us to grow your career?

  • We are the largest fire consultancy in Europe with offices located in Belgium, Finland, Denmark, Italy, and the UK & Ireland. Our reputation for providing innovative, design-focused solutions has made us the consultant of choice for many of Europe’s leading property clients.
  • As a Technical Director you will be an integral part of a dynamic technical team, working with other experienced Engineers, Surveyors and teams including our Forensics division. You will work on the industry's leading technical projects.
  • Working with us offers an exciting range of opportunities to develop your career within a supportive and diverse team that always strives to do the right thing for our people, clients and communities.

Job Overview

Jensen Hughes have a rare and exciting opportunity for a talented Technical Director to join our market leading London team and help us drive excellence across our projects and deliver world class life safety solutions to our varied client base. Our London team have had a record-breaking year with some truly impressive successes to shout about, now is a great time to join us.

As a Technical Director, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring safety and compliance within the built environment. Your expertise will contribute to innovative solutions that protect lives, property, and reputations across diverse industries. This position is integral to our Fire & Building Safety team, where you will collaborate with industry leaders to address complex safety challenges.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain Professional Awareness: Stay updated on technical matters in the fire industry, assimilating and synthesising developing technical issues to provide timely updates and briefings
  • Guide Fire Engineering Professionals: Advise and deliver complex solutions for large construction engineering projects within leading consultancies, ensuring high standards of fire safety engineering.
  • Project Management: Take control of current and future projects, ensuring that financial targets are met and exceeded while developing existing relationships with key clients.
  • Drive Technical Excellence: Foster a culture of technical excellence and team engagement, becoming the go-to expert for developing key client relationships in this discipline.

Strong Python skills, particularly for instrument control, automation and automated test execution. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across semiconductor, process, hardware and quantum engineering teams. title: Product Director – Field Service / Facilities Management
description:
The Joblogic Story

Established in 1998, Joblogic is the UK’s #1 Field Service Management (FSM) software platform. We are a global business with offices in the UK, Pakistan, and Vietnam. Since our management buy-out in 2013, we have grown from ~£500K ARR to ~£35M+ ARR and expanded our team from 11 to 500+ people.

Recently, we secured a strategic growth investment from Vista Equity Partners — a global technology investor specialising in enterprise software. This investment includes over £100 million in new primary capital and will fuel our next phase of growth by accelerating our AI-first roadmap, expanding our platform into CAFM (Computer-Aided Facilities Management) capabilities, and supporting our expansion across Europe and beyond.

With Vista’s backing, we’re transforming from a successful UK business into a global scaling SaaS rocket ship, and we’d love for you to join us on our journey to £100M ARR across international markets.

Joblogic provides software to service contractors who install and maintain the built environment. Our platform helps businesses streamline operations, improve profitability, ensure compliance, and achieve rapid growth. With over 100,000 users across industries including HVAC, plumbing, electrical maintenance, facilities management, and building fabric maintenance, we are entering a new era of intelligent automation, predictive maintenance, and data-driven decision-making for service firms.

We're hiring a Product Director to lead the strategy, vision, and execution of Joblogic's product portfolio across Field Service and Facilities Management. This is a senior leadership role for someone with broad product expertise, deep domain understanding, strong people leadership and mentoring skills, and a proven ability to design, build, and scale AI-powered products in B2B SaaS.

You'll own the product vision and roadmap across our entire FSM and CAFM platform, lead, grow, and mentor a high-performing product team, and partner with the executive team to translate market opportunity into commercial outcomes. You'll also be the driving force behind our AI-first product agenda — defining where AI delivers genuine value, embedding intelligence into core workflows, and ensuring we ship responsibly and at pace.

Above all, this is a people leadership role. You'll be the coach, mentor, and standard-setter for the product team — building careers, raising the craft bar, and creating the kind of environment where ambitious product people do their best work. You'll be equal parts strategist, people leader, and product craftsperson.

What You'll Own

You'll lead product across the Joblogic platform, including:

  • End-to-end FSM and CAFM platform strategy
  • AI-first product initiatives — copilots, agents, predictive maintenance, intelligent scheduling, document intelligence
  • Reactive, PPM, and contract workflows
  • Scheduling, dispatch, and optimisation
  • Field engineer mobile experience
  • Asset lifecycle management
  • Quoting → job → invoicing flows
  • Customer portals and self-service
  • Data, reporting, analytics, and embedded BI
  • Vertical-specific FM workflows (HVAC, M&E, FM, building maintenance)
  • Platform, integrations, and developer experience

What You'll Do

1. Set Product Vision & Strategy

  • Define and communicate a compelling 1–3 year product vision aligned to Joblogic's £100M ARR ambition.
  • Translate market trends, customer insight, and competitive dynamics into a clear, prioritised portfolio roadmap.
  • Make sharp build / buy / partner / sunset decisions across the platform.
  • Partner with the CEO, CPO, CTO, CRO, and CCO to align product strategy with commercial and GTM strategy.

2. Lead the AI-First Product Agenda

  • Own Joblogic's AI product strategy across LLMs, ML, agents, and predictive analytics.
  • Identify the highest-value AI use cases across FSM and CAFM workflows — from intelligent scheduling and dynamic dispatch to predictive maintenance, automated quoting, and engineer copilots.
  • Set principles for responsible, safe, and explainable AI — including data, privacy, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop design.
  • Stay close to the rapidly evolving AI landscape (foundation models, agentic patterns, RAG, fine-tuning, evals) and translate it into pragmatic product bets.
  • Partner with engineering and data leadership to shape the AI platform, data architecture, and ML lifecycle.

3. Mentor, Coach & Lead a High-Performing Product Team

  • Hire, mentor, and develop Product Managers, Senior PMs, and Group PMs across the portfolio — making people growth a core part of how you spend your week.
  • Run regular 1:1s, career conversations, and development plans tailored to each PM's strengths, goals, and growth areas.
  • Coach PMs through complex trade-offs, stakeholder management, difficult prioritisation calls, and high-stakes customer situations.
  • Set the standard for discovery, product craft, written communication, and commercial thinking — and actively raise the bar through feedback and pairing.
  • Establish clear team structure, ownership, levelling, and career paths as the function scales.
  • Build a strong performance culture: clear expectations, candid feedback, recognition, and the courage to make hard people decisions when needed.
  • Foster a psychologically safe, inclusive environment where customer obsession, evidence-led decisions, and outcome ownership thrive.
  • Invest in the team's craft — running PRD reviews, discovery clinics, AI literacy sessions, and post-mortems.

4. Drive Discovery & Customer Insight at Scale

  • Embed deep, continuous discovery across the product team — customer calls, field visits, usage analytics, and qualitative research.
  • Maintain a strong personal connection to customers, engineers, planners, and contract managers.
  • Synthesise insight across verticals to identify portfolio-level opportunities and risks.
  • Champion design partner programs and beta cohorts for new AI and platform capabilities.

5. Partner With UX, Engineering & Data

  • Work hand-in-hand with Design and Engineering leadership to ship simple, scalable, beautifully crafted products.
  • Set quality bars for usability, performance, reliability, and AI behaviour.
  • Ensure mobile and web experiences feel like one cohesive, modern product.
  • Drive a strong data and experimentation culture — from instrumentation to A/B testing to outcome reporting.

6. Own Commercial & Outcome Accountability

  • Own product-led inputs to ARR growth, retention, expansion, and adoption.
  • Define and track product KPIs and OKRs at portfolio and team level.
  • Partner with Sales, CS, and Marketing on positioning, packaging, pricing, and launches.
  • Represent product externally — with customers, partners, analysts, investors, and at industry events.

7. Shape the Operating Model

  • Define how product, design, and engineering work together — rituals, planning cadence, roadmap reviews, discovery operations.
  • Scale the function from a single-product mindset to a multi-product, platform-led operating model.
  • Improve roadmap transparency, prioritisation frameworks, and cross-team dependencies.

What You Bring

Must-Have (Non-Negotiable)

  • Extensive, proven experience in product management, including substantial experience directly managing and mentoring product managers in B2B SaaS.
  • Proven people leadership and mentoring track record — you've built teams from the ground up, developed PMs into Senior PMs and beyond, and can point to specific people whose careers you've helped shape.
  • Proven track record of shipping and scaling AI-powered products — from problem framing through to production, evaluation, and adoption.
  • Deep, hands-on understanding of modern AI/ML and GenAI capabilities: LLMs, agents, RAG, evals, prompt and context engineering, model selection, fine-tuning, and ML lifecycle trade-offs.
  • Broad product expertise across multiple domains — workflows, platform, mobile, data, integrations — and the ability to set strategy across all of them.
  • Experience in Field Service Management, Facilities Management, CAFM/CMMS, Construction Tech, or an adjacent vertical SaaS domain.
  • Strong commercial instinct: comfortable owning revenue-impacting decisions, pricing, packaging, and ROI cases.
  • Demonstrated success building, hiring, retaining, and growing product teams of 5–20+ people.
  • Excellent strategic communication — able to translate complex problems into clear narratives for the board, customers, and engineering teams.

People Leadership & Mentoring

  • A natural mentor — you genuinely enjoy growing other people and take pride in their wins.
  • Skilled at giving direct, kind, actionable feedback — and equally skilled at receiving it.
  • Comfortable having hard conversations: performance, levelling, role changes, and tough prioritisation calls.
  • Strong emotional intelligence — you read teams well, spot burnout early, and create space for people to do their best work.
  • Track record of hiring exceptional product talent and building diverse, inclusive teams.
  • Able to flex coaching style — from new PMs needing structure to senior PMs needing sounding-board sparring.

Product & Leadership Skills

  • Strong product craft: discovery, prioritisation, written specs, systems thinking, and outcome orientation.
  • Ability to operate at multiple altitudes — from 3-year strategy to specific PRDs and AI evaluation criteria.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity, complex stakeholders, and competing priorities.
  • Data- and evidence-led decision making, balanced with strong product intuition.
  • Influence without authority across executive, commercial, and technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Experience scaling product in a PE-backed or high-growth SaaS environment.
  • Exposure to international expansion (Europe, North America).
  • Background in scheduling, optimisation, IoT, or operations research.
  • Experience launching agentic or copilot experiences in B2B workflows.
  • Familiarity with APIs, marketplaces, and partner ecosystems.
  • Engineering, data science, or design background.

Why This Role Matters

Joblogic is evolving from a traditional FSM tool into an AI-first, workflow-intelligent, vertical-focused platform — and the Product Director is the single most important hire in shaping that future.

In this role, you'll directly influence:

  • How 100,000+ users experience Joblogic every day
  • Where and how AI shows up across the platform
  • How quickly we expand into CAFM and international markets
  • The product culture, craft, and bar for the next 100 hires
  • Our path from £25M to £100M ARR

If you want to lead product at a scale where strategy, AI, and execution all matter — and where your decisions show up in the working day of thousands of engineers, planners, and service teams — this is the role.

Joblogic Values

At Joblogic, we expect our team members to champion and embed our core values across their work and customer interactions:

  • Respect – We value every individual and treat colleagues and customers with professionalism, fairness and empathy
  • Obsession with Customers – We place customer outcomes at the centre of everything we do, striving to deliver meaningful value and exceptional experiences
  • Accountability – We take ownership of our actions, decisions and results, holding ourselves and each other to high standards
  • Rethink Tomorrow – We embrace innovation, challenge the status quo and continuously improve how we work to shape a better future

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers. 

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale. 

 

Roles & Responsibilities 

As Head of Electrical Engineering, AI Factory Development at Firmus, you will lead the electrical engineering discipline across every site where Firmus is building and scaling an AI Factory. This is a principal-engineer-equivalent management role within the Build group, accountable for the consistent, high-quality implementation of Firmus's reference electrical design across our global site portfolio.

The role sits within AI Factory Development (Build) and reports to the Head/Director of AI Factory Engineering. You will lead a distributed team of site-based electrical engineers across Indonesia, Australia, and any future geography where Firmus is active. Your remit is delivery, governance, and technical assurance of the electrical design in construction, commissioning, and handover — not ownership of the reference design itself, though you will be a primary and continuous input into the reference design's evolution.

This is a central leadership role. You are the single accountable owner for electrical engineering execution across the Firmus AI Factory estate, the escalation point for electrical technical issues in the field, and the guardian of design intent from tender through energisation. You will work in tight partnership with the reference design owners, the Mechanical and Thermal, Controls, and Physical Networking Heads, and with Construction, Commissioning, and Operations to ensure every site is electrically built, tested, and handed over to standard.

What you will do

As Head of Electrical Engineering, AI Factory Development, you will own the electrical engineering function within the AI Factory Development group. You will define how the reference electrical design is interpreted, adapted for local codes and site conditions, procured, constructed, and commissioned across every Firmus site. You will set the technical bar for MV/LV distribution, UPS and standby generation, protection and coordination, earthing and bonding, power quality, and the electrical interfaces to liquid-cooled AI compute halls.

You will act as the engineering authority for electrical execution across the AI Factory portfolio — accountable for design governance in the field, deviation management, factory and site acceptance testing, commissioning readiness, and safe, reliable energisation. You will operate the change-control and design-review disciplines that keep every site aligned to the Firmus reference design, and you will be the escalation point when local realities require considered deviation or when the reference design itself needs to evolve.

You will not own the development of the reference electrical design, but you will be one of its most important customers and contributors. You will feed operational learnings, site constraints, vendor performance data, and commissioning findings back into the reference design owners, and you will co-develop the electrical standards, templates, and Basis of Design updates that keep Firmus's design ahead of the industry.

Skills & Experiences

You are, first and foremost, an accomplished electrical engineer for mission-critical, high-density digital infrastructure. Above all, you have the temperament of a senior technical leader operating across geographies: strong systems thinking, calm judgement under construction and commissioning pressure, the confidence to challenge design and vendor assumptions constructively, and the communication skill to carry a room of site engineers, a customer technical review, and an executive readout with equal clarity. The ideal candidate will bring a strong technical foundation in electrical power engineering, ideally with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering (power systems preferred) recognised in at least one of Firmus's operating jurisdictions, together with more than 12 years of progressive experience across hyperscale or mission-critical data centre developments, industrial power systems, or comparable high-availability infrastructure. Facilities Manager – Data Center

The Role

The Facilities Manager leads a multidisciplinary team of engineers, technicians, contractors, and service providers responsible for maintaining highly available, mission-critical data center infrastructure.

This position oversees daily facilities operations, maintenance programs, capital projects, vendor performance, safety, compliance, and operational risk. The Facilities Manager drives operational excellence through continuous improvement, sustainability initiatives, strong technical governance, and proactive asset management.

Key Responsibilities

Critical Facilities Operations

  • Lead the day-to-day operation of all critical data center infrastructure.
  • Ensure the availability and reliability of mechanical, electrical, plumbing, security, and life-safety systems.
  • Maintain compliance with Service Level Agreements, operational standards, and uptime objectives.
  • Oversee 24/7 operational support, including incident response, escalation, and recovery.
  • Ensure Standard Operating Procedures, Emergency Operating Procedures, and Methods of Procedure are accurate, current, and consistently followed.
  • Review and approve high-risk maintenance activities and changes affecting critical infrastructure.

Leadership and Team Management

  • Lead, mentor, and develop Critical Facilities Engineers and Technicians.
  • Manage shift schedules, staffing levels, technical training, competency assessments, and performance evaluations.
  • Establish clear responsibilities, performance expectations, and development plans.
  • Foster a culture of safety, accountability, teamwork, ownership, and continuous improvement.
  • Coordinate contractor and vendor activities to ensure work is completed safely, on time, and to the required quality standards.
  • Support recruitment, onboarding, and retention of facilities personnel.

Maintenance and Asset Management

  • Develop and oversee preventive, predictive, condition-based, and corrective maintenance programs.
  • Manage maintenance planning, scheduling, work orders, and equipment records through the Computerized Maintenance Management System.
  • Ensure maintenance activities are properly risk-assessed, documented, approved, and communicated.
  • Monitor equipment condition and lifecycle performance and develop repair, upgrade, and replacement strategies.
  • Ensure maintenance activities minimize operational risk, service disruption, and unplanned downtime.
  • Review recurring equipment failures and implement long-term corrective actions.
  • Maintain accurate asset registers, maintenance records, technical documentation, and spare-parts inventories.

Infrastructure Management

Oversee the operation and maintenance of critical systems, including:

  • Medium-voltage and low-voltage electrical distribution systems
  • Uninterruptible Power Supply systems and battery plants
  • Standby diesel generators
  • Automatic Transfer Switches
  • Switchgear, transformers, protection systems, and electrical panels
  • Chillers and chilled-water systems
  • Computer Room Air Handling and Computer Room Air Conditioning units
  • Air Handling Units
  • Pumps and hydronic systems
  • Heat exchangers
  • Building Management Systems
  • Data Center Infrastructure Management systems
  • Fire detection and suppression systems
  • Security and access-control systems
  • Fuel storage and distribution systems
  • Water-treatment and leak-detection systems

Health, Safety, Environmental and Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with the French Labour Code, applicable EU directives, French environmental regulations, local requirements, and company policies.
  • Maintain a strong health, safety, and environmental culture across the facility.
  • Manage Permit to Work, Lockout/Tagout, electrical isolation, hot-work, confined-space, and contractor-safety programs.
  • Ensure employees and contractors hold the appropriate training, authorizations, and certifications for their assigned work.
  • Lead incident, near-miss, and equipment-failure investigations.
  • Conduct root-cause analysis and ensure corrective and preventive actions are completed.
  • Prepare for and support regulatory inspections, customer assessments, insurance reviews, and internal and external audits.
  • Ensure appropriate emergency-response plans, drills, and escalation procedures are maintained.

Capital Projects and Commissioning

  • Support the planning and delivery of infrastructure upgrades, replacements, expansions, and capital projects.
  • Review technical designs, specifications, risk assessments, and commissioning plans.
  • Coordinate project work with operations teams to minimize risk to live services.
  • Participate in factory acceptance testing, site acceptance testing, commissioning, and integrated systems testing.
  • Ensure complete operational handover, including training, asset documentation, test results, warranties, and as-built drawings.
  • Monitor project budgets, schedules, risks, and contractor performance.

Financial and Vendor Management

  • Develop and manage the facilities operating and capital budgets.
  • Forecast maintenance, staffing, utility, equipment-replacement, and service-contract costs.
  • Review maintenance contracts, statements of work, and service-level agreements.
  • Monitor vendor performance against established service levels and key performance indicators.
  • Conduct regular vendor-performance reviews and implement improvement plans when required.
  • Support the procurement of equipment, spare parts, technical services, and facility-related contracts.
  • Identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency without compromising safety, reliability, or compliance.

Sustainability and Energy Management

  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve energy efficiency and reduce environmental impact.
  • Monitor Power Usage Effectiveness, energy consumption, water consumption, and carbon-related performance.
  • Support sustainability programs and environmental reporting requirements.
  • Work with engineering and operations teams to optimize cooling, electrical loading, and equipment performance.
  • Evaluate energy-saving initiatives while protecting system reliability and redundancy.

Operational Reporting

Track, analyze, and report key operational metrics, including:

  • Infrastructure availability
  • Preventive maintenance completion
  • Corrective-maintenance backlog
  • Mean Time to Repair
  • Mean Time Between Failures
  • Power Usage Effectiveness
  • Energy and water consumption
  • Capacity utilization
  • Incident and alarm trends
  • Vendor performance

  • Budget performance

  • Equivalent technical education combined with substantial relevant experience may also be considered.

Experience

Qui sommes-nous?

Artefact est une société de conseil et d'ingénierie française spécialisée en data et IA, et leader en Europe, qui depuis plus de 10 ans est spécialisée dans la conception et le déploiement de technologies d’intelligence artificielle et de solutions data-driven. Basé à Paris, nous sommes aujourd’hui présents dans 27 pays sur tous les continents et comptons 2500 collaborateurs. 

Notre mission est d’aider les entreprises à exploiter tout le potentiel de l’IA et de la data en développant des solutions sur-mesure adaptées à leurs enjeux métiers. En tant que pionniers dans ce domaine, nous allions expertise technologique et excellence opérationnelle, en collaborant avec les plus grands acteurs du marché. Nos clients couvrent tous les secteurs clés de l’économie – industrie, retail, luxe, grande consommation, santé, finance – et incluent des grands groupes internationaux.

La performance de nos services data repose sur une réelle expertise technologique en Intelligence Artificielle et des compétences métiers acquises auprès de nos 1000+ clients dans le monde, tels que Ubisoft, Sisley, OVH, Thales, Edenred, GRDF, EMG…  La force d'Artefact repose sur un mix unique d'atouts: des technologies data de pointe, des méthodes agiles permettant de délivrer très rapidement les projets et des équipes composées des meilleurs experts dans leurs domaines (consultants data, data analysts, data scientists, data engineers, et des experts du digital marketing sur tous les canaux).

Dans ce contexte, notre practice Digital Marketing recherche pour accompagner sa croissance un(e) Consultant(e) Senior SEO/GEO.

Au sein de l’équipe AI Search, qui déploie des stratégies intégrées organiques (SEO/GEO) et payantes (SEA/GEA) pour ses clients — le/la Consultant(e) Senior SEO/GEO aura pour missions :

  • Délivrer des projets SEO/GEO sous la supervision des directeurs AI Search et des consultants digital marketing
  • Assurer l’interface avec le(s) partenaire(s) outil pour l’extraction des données
  • Produire des documents d’analyse: insights, benchmarks, recommandations et plan d’actions prioriser
  • Suivre la bonne mise en oeuvre des recommandations
     

Profil recherché:

  • Formation Bac +4/5, avec au minimum 3 ans d’expérience en SEO en agence spécialisée
  • Des bases en GEO sont un plus pour la candidature, mais non obligatoires
  • Rigueur et maîtrise des KPI’s et du Web Analytics
  • Anglais courant

Pourquoi nous rejoindre :

  • Artefact est the place to be: venez construire l'avenir du data marketing et de l’AI Search
  • Progression: chaque nouvelle mission offre de nouveaux défis et de nouvelles opportunités d'apprendre
  • Culture: rejoignez une des meilleures équipes européennes en data marketing
  • Entreprenariat : vous rejoindrez une équipe d'entrepreneurs motivés dont l’objectif est la croissance continue et pérenne de l’entreprise

 Process de recrutement : 

  1. HR call : Talent Acquisition Specialist  
  2. Entretien avec un Directeur AI Search et une consultante senior SEO (1h en présentiel + 1 étude de cas qui sera effectuée en direct)
  3. Entretien avec un Digital & Data marketing Partner (45 min en présentiel)

Rémunération

Fourchette de rémunération prévue : 40k€ à 46k€ brut/ annuel selon profil 

Chez Artefact, nous recrutons nos collaborateurs uniquement en fonction de nos besoins et des qualités propres de chaque candidat. Nous assurons le développement de leurs compétences professionnelles et de leurs responsabilités sans discrimination d’aucune sorte, notamment de croyances, de genre, d’âge, de situation d'handicap, d’origine ethnique, d’orientation sexuelle, d’appartenance à une organisation politique, religieuse, syndicale ou à une minorité.

title: Manager Cloud Architect - Paris
description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Artefact est une société de conseil et d'ingénierie française spécialisée en data et IA, et leader en Europe, qui depuis 10 ans est spécialisée dans la conception et le déploiement de technologies d’intelligence artificielle et de solutions data-driven. Basé à Paris, nous sommes aujourd’hui présents dans 24 pays sur tous les continents et comptons 1 700 collaborateurs. 

Notre mission est d’aider les entreprises à exploiter tout le potentiel de l’IA et de la data en développant des solutions sur-mesure adaptées à leurs enjeux métiers. En tant que pionniers dans ce domaine, nous allions expertise technologique et excellence opérationnelle, en collaborant avec les plus grands acteurs du marché. Nos clients couvrent tous les secteurs clés de l’économie – industrie, retail, luxe, grande consommation, santé, finance – et incluent des grands groupes internationaux. 

Au-delà du conseil, nous nous engageons activement pour une IA éthique et accessible. Nous avons lancé la "School of Data" pour favoriser la reconversion vers les métiers de la tech, créé un Centre de Recherche en IA à Paris et Shanghai.

 

Vos missions :

o Analyse et compréhension des besoins clients 

  • Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec le business en animant des ateliers pour étudier les besoins des clients 
  • Vous êtes force de proposition dans la formalisation du problème, afin de s’assurer de cerner le vrai besoin
  • Vous vous appropriez la culture et l’écosystème du client afin de maîtriser son contexte et assurer le cadrage technologique

o Conception de solutions

  • Vous préconisez les solutions et les architectures cibles, en estimant la faisabilité ainsi que les risques d’implémentation de chaque projet
  • Vous travaillez avec les directions techniques des clients afin d’identifier les solutions les plus pertinentes vis à vis de l’organisation
  • Vous maitrisez les différents flux de données mis en oeuvre dans la solution ainsi que leur transformation, leur stockage et leur distribution dans un contexte Cloud (GCP et Azure)
  • Vous mêlez pragmatisme et vision, créant des solutions réalistes qui répondent aux besoins futurs, et faisant preuve de scalabilité et fiabilité

o Suivi de l’implémentation

  • Vous travaillez avec les équipes de développement et les data scientists afin de guider et faciliter la production et le déploiement des solutions
  • Vous travaillez avec les équipes business afin d’itérer sur les solutions et travailler en agilité, tout en raffinant votre compréhension du besoin
  • Vous collaborez avec les équipes client afin de faciliter la prise d’ownership de la solution, et sa pérennité 

 

Votre mindset :

  • Ingénieux(se), vous aimez résoudre des problèmes et mobiliser les énergies des équipes 
  • Vos qualités d’investigation vous permettent d’obtenir toutes les informations  pour construire la meilleure solution répondant au besoin du client 
  • Curieux(se), vous êtes en constante veille des nouvelles technologies pour comprendre en profondeur ce qui sera utile pour livrer les futures architectures data
  • Bienveillant(e), vous contribuez à la montée en compétences des équipes de développement autour des technologies 
  • Business oriented, vous interagissez avec nos clients (externes et internes) et toutes les parties prenantes techniques pour répondre aux exigences complexes et y apporter les solutions adéquates.

 

Profil :

  • Issu(e) d’une formation ingénieur ou informatique, vous avez une excellente connaissance du fonctionnement des principaux composants d’une architecture technique moderne.
  • Vous disposez d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience, qui vous permet de prendre de la hauteur vis à vis des sujets que vous traitez, pour autant vous possédez une ou plusieurs expertises : Architectures Data, Cloud, Architecture du SI, IoT, Devops…
  • Vous avez au moins une expérience dans le conseil.
  • Vous maitrisez l’anglais et vous avez des expériences réussies dans un environnement similaire (SSII, consulting ...).

Les plus:

  • connaissance spécifique pointue des technologies cloud de Google (GCP), Microsoft (Azure) ou Amazon (AWS);
  • expérience en développement logiciel

Pourquoi nous rejoindre 

  • Stack complète à la pointe de l’innovation : Python, Kubernetes, Kafka, Spark, Google Cloud Platform (BQ, Dataflow, Compute Engine, PubSub, AppEngine…) , Airflow, Docker
  • Diversité des projets, par exemple (non exhaustif) :
    - Mise en place de Datalake
    - Création de chatbot
    - Industrialisation d’algorithme de machine learning
    - Définition de stratégie Data 
  • Environnement jeune et challengeant, équipe compétente
  • Rayonnement international et entreprise en croissance

title: Director – International Relations and Diplomacy Programs

Collaborate with Employability team and devise and implement measures and initiatives to boost students’ employability and career success. Manage faculty workload and faculty assignment in collaboration with the other academic leaders. Any other duties assigned by the Provost, President or Campus Director. Proven experience and demonstrated excellence in higher education, administration, and industry experience. Academic program design and review and managing faculty and staff.
